standard_prerequisites.name: Strict supremum of a set of ordinals
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Unit ordinals, definition defsupstrict (supremum not attained), cited with its marker at proof line 482
standard_prerequisites.use: Shapes alpha as supstrict of the witnessing ordinals so that membership in alpha is what places elements into V_alpha.

standard_prerequisites.name: Basic properties of the V-hierarchy
standard_prerequisites.use: Line 490: x subseteq V_delta with delta in alpha yields x in V_alpha via the cumulation clause.

standard_prerequisites.name: Foundation / set induction
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: ZFC axiom of Foundation as used at line 494: a non-empty D contains a member disjoint from D
standard_prerequisites.use: The reductio paragraph: minimal counterexample B in D with D cap B empty.

core_obligations: Two definitions (proof lines 481-487): D collects elements of A never covered by any V_delta, and alpha is the strict supremum of the ordinals witnessing first inclusion of A-elements.
D empty gives the bound (lines 488-491): every x in A has a least separating delta, delta in alpha, so x in V_alpha by the hierarchy properties lemma.

Reductio for D empty (lines 492-503): Foundation gives B in D with D cap B empty; transitivity of A puts every x in B outside D, so each x has a covering V_delta; the strict supremum beta of B's witnessing ordinals bounds B inside V_beta, contradicting B in D.
proof_roadmap: Define the exception set D and the candidate bound alpha.
Show D empty would finish the proof via cumulation.
Assume D non-empty, take a Foundation-minimal B in D.
Bound B's elements' ranks by beta and contradict B in D.
